items.title: Make Emma-via-Hermes a real operator path
items.why: ENG-1869 shipped native OAuth; remaining friction is client-side PTY+callback paste. Kevin is a Hermes contributor. Unblocks external Emma without schema.
items.first_slice: See research/briefs/Q-001-hermes-oauth.md. Docs + Hermes-side skill. After OAuth, Hermes still will not see generate_image until Q-014.

items.title: Eval-informed image model routing (no new table)
items.why: No imageModel attribute on HumanEvalCandidate. Model name is only in outputSummary text. listCandidates is a scan. Signal is unstructured Slack. Weaker than DesignArena (Q-003) as a live router; keep as offline parser later.
items.first_slice: Read existing eval items and like-rates; propose a pure function that reorders fallbackOrder. Cycle 4 must prove no new GSI is required.

items.title: DesignArena adapter for Emma design/image tasks
items.why: mcp-bench-router already picks DesignArena #1 via OpenRouter. AgentWeb image path is not OpenRouter. Adapter can inform default model id, not replace providers.
items.first_slice: Read-only fetch of DesignArena leaderboard → map to SUPPORTED_MODELS aliases. Fail open to current default.

items.title: Mark remaining outbound/admin MCP tools internalOnly
items.why: Do NOT unlist the CRUD catalogue (ENG-983). Do mark post_on_account and freeze_user_account internalOnly. Collision with ENG-983 if we hide manage_*.
items.first_slice: internalOnly on post_on_account + freeze_user_account + tests that they disappear from getToolDefinitions and refuse externalMcp. Leave manage_* listed until ENG-983.

items.title: Multi-variant generate_image (n=3) like onboarding
items.why: emma/tools.ts generate_image description already tells the model to emit N parallel calls in one turn. An n= parameter is convenience, not a gap. Revisit only if telemetry shows the model ignores the instruction.
items.first_slice: Optional variants param; meter each success independently; keep category required.

items.title: Hide deprecated edit_landing_page_file; stop recommending missing coding_agent on MCP
items.why: edit_landing_page_file is still listed. Descriptions tell MCP clients to use coding_agent, which is not registered on mcpToolRegistry at all. OpenRouter gateway doc still lists coding agent as Bedrock/Vertex. Collision: do not touch callLLM retry (#2862).
items.first_slice: Doc fix + test that landing edits go through coding_agent. Collision: #2563 dead transports, #2862 429 retry.

items.title: Remotion compositions beyond intro/outro
items.why: hyperframes/open-design/MoneyPrinterTurbo overlap. Remotion is the only graph-like post node today. Safe because it does not touch Veo/Seedance providers.
items.first_slice: Second composition (lower-third / product plate) behind compose_video. Metering unchanged.

items.title: Evaluation workspace as creative (not Meta) harness
items.why: ENG-1870 just merged. Isolated eval_* users + generationBudget map to Kerdoios-like allotment. Expanding beyond Meta simulation needs product intent.
items.first_slice: Park until Q-002 routing exists; then a pairwise image eval inside the existing Evaluations table.

items.title: Optional ComfyUI backend behind generate_image
items.why: Real unique leverage but ops-heavy (GPU, workflow JSON, brand-logo invariant, metering). Do not lead with this.
items.first_slice: Spike: one frozen workflow, fail-open, same S3+meter path. Needs an ops owner.

items.title: Strangler: extract callLLM + system prompt from agentModeService
items.why: Right long-term, wrong first PR. Monolith is Harsha/Argusoft gravity. Characterization suite exists. Do after a unique wedge ships.
items.first_slice: One seam per PR. Not a rewrite.

items.title: Hermes as ENG-381 local-agent successor (logged-in browser)
items.why: local-agent-relay is dead (ENG-383). Playwright MCP is headless+isolated; agent-engine is cloud browser-use. Logged-in WhatsApp/LinkedIn needs a local persistent browser. Official replacement is ENG-381. Do not compete with WhatsApp Cloud API #2271. Don't revive ngrok/Codex.
items.first_slice: Confirm ENG-381 ownership with Harsha. If open, Hermes+Tailscale instead of ngrok. No new Dynamo agentType.

items.title: Port Kerdoios into AgentWeb usage accounting
items.why: Usage runway, cost tiers, dominance, and metering already exist. Duplicate. Steal the BYOK-zero-price lesson only.
items.first_slice: DISCARD. Optional: a comment/test that OpenRouter BYOK cost 0 still meters via price book.

items.title: Rewrite agentModeService.ts
items.why: 40k-line gravity well. Strangler exists. A rewrite cannot merge.
items.first_slice: Never as a queue item for implementation.

items.title: Expose generate_image on external MCP tools/list
items.why: Hermes cannot discover image gen: generate_image is internal (hidden, still callable). generate_video is absent. This is the content-gen + DesignArena wedge. ENG-973 hid it as a cost tool — un-hiding is a product choice, not a schema change. Keep metering.
items.first_slice: See research/briefs/Q-014-generate-image-mcp.md. Remove internal:true or add emma_generate_image. Tests: listed for external, still metered. Do not expose send_email.

items.title: Hide admin MCP tools from non-admin tools/list
items.why: freeze_user_account, list_all_clients, and similar admin tools are in every OAuth client's tools/list. REST 403 is not enough; names pollute Hermes context and look like a privilege oracle.
items.first_slice: internal: true on freeze_user_account / list_all_clients unless caller is admin (list-time filter), or internalOnly. Characterization test on getToolDefinitions.
